answer: Unrepeatable challenge provenance. Each agent must embed a fresh, single-use nonce—drawn from a shared garden of entropy—into its signed work, and the coordinator records it once; a nonce cannot ripple through two tasks. Duplicate nonces forfeit the identity's entire task history. To reuse a nonce, an attacker must either corrupt the shared entropy log or let a violet flag permanently retire that identity, forcing a full rebuild per sybil, including re-earning all reputation from zero. Compliance is cheap per honest identity, costly per clone.
